name: security
description: Server protection: anti-nuke detection with automatic quarantine.
short: Server protection: anti-nuke thresholds, raid detection, and verification.

configFields.label: Lock Mod Commands During Panic
configFields.description: While panic mode is active, only the server owner or whoever triggered it may run moderation commands.

configFields.label: Channels to Lock
configFields.description: Channel IDs locked by /panic. Blank locks every text channel.

configFields.label: Anti-Nuke
configFields.description: Watch the audit log for mass destructive actions.

configFields.label: Detection Window
configFields.description: Sliding window in seconds for counting actions.

configFields.label: Trusted Roles
configFields.description: Role IDs exempt from anti-nuke.

configFields.label: Security Log Channel
configFields.description: Channel for anti-nuke alerts (falls back to mod log).

configFields.label: Max Bans
configFields.description: Bans allowed per executor within the window.

configFields.label: Response — Bans
configFields.description: Action taken when the ban threshold trips.

configFields.label: Max Kicks
configFields.description: Kicks allowed per executor within the window.

configFields.label: Response — Kicks
configFields.description: Action taken when the kick threshold trips.

configFields.label: Max Channel Deletes
configFields.description: Channel deletions allowed per executor within the window.

configFields.label: Response — Channel Deletes
configFields.description: Action taken when the channel-delete threshold trips.

configFields.label: Max Role Deletes
configFields.description: Role deletions allowed per executor within the window.

configFields.label: Response — Role Deletes
configFields.description: Action taken when the role-delete threshold trips.

configFields.label: Max Webhook Creates
configFields.description: Webhook creations allowed per executor within the window.

configFields.label: Response — Webhook Creates
configFields.description: Action taken when the webhook-create threshold trips.

configFields.label: Max Vanity URL Changes
configFields.description: Vanity invite code changes allowed per executor within the window.

configFields.label: Max Dangerous Permission Grants
configFields.description: Times @everyone can be granted a dangerous permission (Administrator, Manage Roles, etc.) per executor within the window before response fires. The grant itself is always reverted immediately.

configFields.label: Max Quarantine Bypass Attempts
configFields.description: Times an executor can attempt to change a quarantined member's roles per executor within the window before response fires. The change itself is always reverted immediately.

configFields.label: Join Gate
configFields.description: Screen new members for raids and throwaway accounts.

configFields.label: Min Account Age (hours)
configFields.description: Accounts younger than this are gated. 0 disables the check.

configFields.label: Raid Join Count
configFields.description: Joins within the raid window that activate raid mode.

configFields.label: Raid Window (seconds)
configFields.description: Window for counting joins toward raid detection.

configFields.label: Gate Action
configFields.description: Action applied to gated joiners during a raid.

configFields.label: Raid Response Scope
configFields.description: Apply the raid action to every joiner, or only ones flagged suspicious (no avatar, low account age, similar username to a recent joiner, or bulk-created).

configFields.label: Raid Warn Roles
configFields.description: Role IDs mentioned in the log message when raid mode activates.

configFields.label: Filter: No Avatar
configFields.description: Flag members who have never set a custom avatar.

configFields.label: No Avatar Action
configFields.description: Action taken when the no-avatar filter trips.

configFields.label: Filter: Min Account Age
configFields.description: Flag accounts younger than the configured age.

configFields.label: Min Account Age (hours)
configFields.description: Accounts younger than this trip the filter.

configFields.label: Min Age Action
configFields.description: Action taken when the min-age filter trips.

configFields.label: Filter: Unverified Bots
configFields.description: Flag bot accounts that aren't Discord-verified.

configFields.label: Unverified Bot Action
configFields.description: Action taken when the unverified-bot filter trips.

configFields.label: Filter: Username Pattern
configFields.description: Flag members whose username contains a configured substring.

configFields.label: Username Patterns
configFields.description: Substrings matched (case-insensitively) against usernames, one per line.

configFields.label: Username Pattern Action
configFields.description: Action taken when the username-pattern filter trips.

configFields.label: Filter: Advertising Account
configFields.description: Flag members whose display name itself is a link or invite (ad/scam accounts).

configFields.label: Advertising Account Action
configFields.description: Action taken when the advertising-account filter trips.

configFields.label: Verification
configFields.description: Require members to verify via the panel for the verified role.

configFields.label: Verified Role
configFields.description: Role granted after passing the emoji captcha.

configFields.label: Pending Role
configFields.description: Role assigned on join and removed once verified. Optional.

configFields.label: Verify Timeout (minutes)
configFields.description: How long a member has to pass the captcha.

configFields.label: Kick on Timeout
configFields.description: Kick members who don't verify before the timeout.

configFields.label: Verification Mode
configFields.description: How members prove they're human: emoji sequence, one-click, or a web challenge on the dashboard.

configFields.label: Verification Target
configFields.description: Require verification from everyone, or only accounts flagged as suspicious (new or no avatar).

configFields.label: Backup Interval (hours)
configFields.description: How often to snapshot role/channel structure while Anti-Nuke is on, for the Restore System.

configFields.label: Backups to Keep
configFields.description: Older backups past this count are pruned.
